verdict.rationale: Apify's own client docs state that scraped datasets can be exported as JSON, alongside CSV, XLSX and XML. The client guides also show running an Actor and retrieving its results as dataset items, for example loading them into Pandas. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the JSON item structure or schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration of JSON output.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON
